title: Is Cold Showers Actually Worth It in 2026?
description: I tried cold showers every single day for a month and tracked energy, mood, and sleep quality. Here is what actually changed.
transcript: Have you ever wondered if all those cold shower influencers are actually onto something, or if it's just hype? I decided to find out the hard way. For thirty days straight, no exceptions, freezing cold water first thing in the morning. By day seven I wanted to quit. By day thirty something had genuinely shifted.
